newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS IDLE AHEAD, GAP OVER BUNDS STEADY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS IDLE AHEAD, GAP OVER BUNDS STEADY.

text.p: stronger with overseas after lower than expected US payrolls
data reported on Thursday, dealers said.
Some delers saw scope for 2006 bond to yield below 5.90
"There was interest at 5.88-5.89 percent levels after the
session," one said. But eyes were on German Bunds.
"Europe is quiet today because of the US holiday," one
dealer stated. The gap over Bunds was seen steady around 30
basis points and dealers said there was no impact from Finnish
May money supply data showing a 2.4 percent rise in M2.
Bundesbanks Otmar Issing speech due at 1100/0800 GMT was not
expected to give essential information, dealers said.
One analyst was looking for comments about the German mark's
weakening against the dollar which he said had raised concerns
about potential inflation risks in Germany.
